profile.headline: AI/ML Engineer & Software Engineer | CS ’26 @ University of South Carolina | Incoming Full-Time SWE @ Vanguard | RAG • AWS Bedrock • LangChain • Python • Java • React • FastAPI
profile.summary:
AI/ML Engineer and full-stack developer focused on shipping production GenAI systems. Six months at Vanguard building LLM-powered tooling that lifted live-chat agent throughput by 50% and now serves 100+ customer-service operators every day.

What I build:
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines on AWS Bedrock — ingestion, embedding, vector retrieval, and prompt orchestration.
• Full-stack web applications with React / Next.js / FastAPI / Spring Boot, deployed on Docker + AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CDK).
• Distributed systems for hard problems — engineered a Python/FastAPI/PostgreSQL/MinIO version-control system for collaborative 3D Blender workflows, where Git and Perforce break down on binary scenes.

Recent shipped work:
→ Vanguard (Conversational Channels, May–Oct 2025): Built a GenAI assistant integrated with the Genesys agent platform, delivering real-time response suggestions to 100+ chat agents using AWS Bedrock + RAG over the internal KMaaS knowledge base. Re-architected chat-flow logic to raise the agent concurrency ceiling from 2 to 3 conversations. Led adversarial (red-team) testing of the prompt stack before launch.
→ Document Renaming AI Tool: LangChain + Claude API classifier wired to a Next.js front end — cut manual file-organization time by ~80%.
→ Blender Version Control System (capstone): Object-level locking and visual merge-conflict resolution for binary 3D scenes. Custom Python add-on talking to a Dockerized FastAPI/PostgreSQL/MinIO backend.

Foundation: BS Computer Science at the University of South Carolina (3.95 GPA, May 2026), Minor in Business Administration. Coursework in Distributed Systems, Applied Machine Learning, Operating Systems, Database Design. President's List, Dean's Scholar. 600+ students taught as an undergraduate TA in Python, Java, JavaScript, and Git.

Stack: Python • Java • TypeScript • SQL • C++  |  AWS Bedrock • Claude API • LangChain • RAG • Prompt Engineering  |  React • Next.js • FastAPI • Spring Boot • Docker • PostgreSQL • MinIO

Joining Vanguard as a full-time Software Engineer in August 2026. Always interested in chatting about LLM systems, distributed infrastructure, and applied ML — github.com/aarshrpatel

positions.title: Co-Op Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Software Engineer Co-op on the Conversational Channels team within Vanguard's Aioli (AI) division, shipping GenAI tooling for the customer-service platform serving 100+ live chat agents.

• Built a GenAI assistant integrated with Genesys Cloud CX, using AWS Bedrock and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline over the internal Knowledge Management as a Service (KMaaS) corpus to deliver real-time response suggestions to agents handling customer inquiries.
• Re-architected chat-flow logic to lift the agent concurrency ceiling from 2 to 3 concurrent conversations — a ~50% throughput increase across the agent fleet.
• Designed a TypeScript data structure for chat-session storage and retrieval that cut lookup latency by 15% and prepared the system for downstream LLM integration.
• Developed a GenAI-driven phone-number-update workflow inside the customer-support bot — including prompt engineering, end-to-end testing, and adversarial (red-team) evaluation for safety, prompt-injection resistance, and reliability before production launch.
• Backend services in Java + Spring Boot exposing RESTful APIs to a React front end; collaborated cross-functionally in an Agile/SCRUM environment with PMs, designers, and ML engineers.

Stack: AWS Bedrock • RAG • Java • Spring Boot • TypeScript • React • RESTful APIs • Genesys Cloud CX • Prompt Engineering
positions.insights: Skills: Testing · Large Language Models (LLM) · Generative AI · Prompt Engineering · Web Services API · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

positions.locationName: Columbia, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
I am proud to have volunteered with AASOA of SC, a non-profit organization dedicated to empowering single store owners in the face of formidable competition from larger corporations. positions.title: Student Intern
positions.locationName: Summerville, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
During my internship at REV Federal Credit Union, I had the opportunity to immerse myself in the dynamic world of financial services. This experience was invaluable as it provided me with a comprehensive understanding of the daily operations within the credit union while also deepening my knowledge of the regulatory landscape that governs credit unions and banks.

Key Learning and Achievements:

-Versatile Role Shifting: Over the course of my internship, I had the privilege of working in three distinct roles within the credit union. This allowed me to gain a well-rounded perspective on the various functions and responsibilities within the organization, from member services to operations and more.

-Regulatory Insights: One of the critical aspects of my internship involved learning the intricate rules and regulations that credit unions and banks must adhere to. This knowledge proved essential in ensuring that the credit union operated in compliance with industry standards.

-Enhancing Operational Efficiency: I actively contributed to enhancing operational efficiency by identifying process improvements and implementing best practices. My role involved streamlining workflows and collaborating with team members to achieve operational excellence.

-Member-Centric Approach: Throughout my internship, I remained focused on the credit union's mission to provide exceptional service to its members. I learned the importance of building strong relationships with members and addressing their financial needs effectively.

My internship at REV Federal Credit Union was a valuable stepping stone in my career journey. It not only equipped me with practical skills but also instilled in me a deep appreciation for the financial industry's complexity and the importance of compliance and member satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Teller Operations · Team-focused · Communication · Problem Solving

positions.title: Videographer/Photographer
positions.locationName: Orangeburg, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
During my time as a Videographer/Photographer Volunteer at the Hindu Temple & Cultural Center of Orangeburg, I had the privilege of combining my passion for visual storytelling with a meaningful cause. I dedicated my skills to document and capture the vibrant cultural and spiritual activities of this esteemed nonprofit organization.

Key Achievements:

-Capturing Cultural Heritage: I had the honor of preserving the rich cultural heritage and traditions of the Hindu community through my lens. My work helped showcase the temple's events, festivals, and rituals, allowing a broader audience to appreciate and understand this beautiful culture.

-Content Creation: I created a diverse range of visual content, including photographs and videos, which were used for promotional materials, social media, and educational resources. These visuals played a pivotal role in increasing the temple's online presence and engagement.

-Community Engagement: My role allowed me to connect with the temple's dedicated community members and volunteers. I collaborated closely with temple leaders and event organizers to ensure that the essence of each event was captured effectively.

-Contributing to Outreach: Through my visual storytelling, I contributed to the temple's outreach efforts, helping attract new members and supporters. I also assisted in documenting charitable initiatives and events organized by the temple for the betterment of the local community.

This volunteer experience was not just about capturing moments; it was about being part of a community and helping to preserve and promote its traditions and values. It was a deeply rewarding experience that allowed me to combine my creative skills with a sense of purpose.

positions.title: Junior Executive Producer - SwampcatTV
positions.locationName: Manning, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As the Junior Executive Producer for the SwampcatTV Team at Laurence Manning Academy, I had the privilege of leading a dedicated team of cameramen and ensuring the seamless live streaming of school events and games. This role allowed me to develop valuable leadership and technical skills while delivering high-quality live broadcasts.

Key Responsibilities and Achievements:

Production Coordination: I was responsible for orchestrating the entire live production process, from planning and setup to execution. This involved designating cameramen to strategic positions, coordinating shot changes, and ensuring that the live stream ran smoothly.

Team Management: Leading a team of cameramen required effective communication and leadership skills. I provided guidance and direction to ensure that each team member understood their role and responsibilities, resulting in cohesive and professional broadcasts.

Technical Proficiency: Operating in a live broadcast environment demanded a strong technical aptitude. I became proficient in video switching and managing live streaming equipment to deliver a polished and engaging viewer experience.

Problem Solving: In the fast-paced world of live production, unexpected challenges could arise. I developed quick problem-solving skills, adapting to changing circumstances and ensuring that any technical issues were resolved swiftly to minimize disruptions.

Enhancing Viewer Engagement: Our broadcasts played a crucial role in connecting the school community with its events. I worked to enhance viewer engagement by incorporating dynamic camera angles and maintaining a high level of professionalism in our productions.

My time as the Junior Executive Producer at SwampcatTV Team was not just about technical proficiency; it was about leadership, teamwork, and the ability to deliver exceptional live broadcasts. This experience provided me with valuable skills that I continue to apply in my career.

projects.title: Blender Version Control System (Senior Capstone)
projects.description:
A distributed version control system for collaborative 3D Blender workflows — designed to handle the binary scene files where Git and Perforce break down. Co-led a 5-person team across two semesters as Scrum Lead and full-stack developer.

• Engineered an object-level diffing and locking model so multiple artists can work on a single .blend file without overwriting each other's work, with visual merge-conflict resolution.
• Built the backend in Python + FastAPI exposing a REST API; metadata in PostgreSQL, binary asset storage in MinIO, all containerized with Docker for reproducible deployment.
• Authored a custom Blender add-on (Python bpy) that surfaces commit / push / pull / lock operations directly inside the editor — no leaving the artist workflow.
• Owned sprint planning, GitHub project board, and bi-weekly demos to faculty advisors.

Stack: Python • FastAPI • PostgreSQL • MinIO • Docker • Blender Python API (bpy) • REST APIs
